title: 第4740章 认出身份第4739章 九头鸟一族
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九阳武神第4740章认出身份（..la）这么多的开天神在极短的时间内，就已经将那匹马镇压在一个小范围空间之内，左冲右突都无法冲破包围圈。
一个嘴巴尖长的高瘦老者腾空而起，快速逼近那匹已经被团团围困的马，脸上带着冷漠的笑容。
“我劝你还是乖乖束手就缚吧，否则你的下场只有一个，那就是被打得粉身碎骨。”
那个高瘦老者冷笑说道。
“九头鸟一族，很好，今天的事情我记住了。”
那匹马虽然身陷重围，但是并没有露出太过明显的惊慌之意，而是在左冲右突，寻找可能逃走的机会。
但在这种情况之下，他也知道自己想要成功突围希望太小了。
“不知道其他那些家伙现在怎么样了？”
这匹马突然想到了其他的那些同伴，之前那十一头动物是聚在一起，共同在这一片星空之中探险寻宝的。
但是在探险寻宝的过程中和几个大势力的人马发生了冲突，后来就成为了被追杀的对象。
在被追杀的过程中，十一头动物开始走散，向着不同的方向逃亡。
这匹马凭借着极快的速度，逃亡了很长时间，但最终还是被堵在这里了。
“看来你还不死心。”
那个高瘦的老者冷笑说道。
说话的同时他右手突然伸出，十根手指不断变长，变得弯曲，然后整只手掌就化成了一只锋利的鸟爪，向着那匹马抓了过去。
大量的诡异符文缭绕在鸟爪之上，封印前方的空间。
那匹马顿时就感觉自己所在的空间受到了可怕的镇压，身体一沉，行动开始变得艰难起来。
这个高瘦老者是一个第二重开天神，实力很强，而且他是九头鸟一族的长老，修炼了很多九头鸟一族的核心传承。虽然只是随随便便地向前一抓，但是已经动用了九头鸟的核心秘术，威力十分可怕。
“我们大阴间对这匹马的尸体以及灵魂体很感兴趣。
这样吧，它的本源血脉你们九头鸟一族可以拿去，但是它的尸体还有魂魄，我们大阴间收了。”

突然间，一个黑袍人降落在众人的眼前，开口说道。
“大阴间的开天神！”
其他人看到这个黑袍人不由得目光一缩，露出了忌惮的表情。
大阴间在第九虚空是一个很强的大势力。
“在你们拿走他身体各个部位之前，他必须交给我们监守者阵营。
不过你们放心，我们监守者阵营并不需要他的躯体，而只是要用他来做一个诱饵引出一个家伙。”
突然间，远处有一个中年男子大步而来，开口说道。
“看来监守者阵营已经认出了马前辈的身份。”
叶云飞看到那个中年男子，不由得心中暗道。
其实之前在另外那八个虚空，叶云飞带领人马对战监守者阵营大军的过程中，那十一头动物就已经出来参加战斗，帮忙对付监守者阵营的人马。所以监守者阵营已经知道了这十一头动物的存在。
这段时间这十一头动物在这片星空中被那么多大势力追杀，终于引起了监守者阵营的注意，然后他们就认出了这十一头动物的身份。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Nine Yang Martial God Chapter 4740 Recognition of Identity (..la) So many Kaitian Gods have suppressed the horse in a small space in a very short period of time, and they can't break through the encirclement even if they rush left and right.
A tall, thin old man with a long pointed mouth rose into the air and quickly approached the horse that was already surrounded by a group of people, with a cold smile on his face.
"I advise you to just keep your hands tied, otherwise you will only end up with one end, and that is to be beaten to pieces."
The tall, thin old man said with a sneer.
"Nine-headed Bird Clan, very good, I remember what happened today."
Although the horse was trapped in a tight siege, it did not show any obvious signs of panic. Instead, it dashed left and right, looking for opportunities to escape.
But under this situation, he also knew that his hope of successfully breaking through was too small.
"I wonder how the other guys are doing now?"
The horse suddenly thought of its other companions. The eleven animals had gathered together to explore and hunt for treasure in the starry sky.
However, during the expedition to hunt for treasure, he clashed with several powerful people, and later became the target of being hunted down.
While being chased, the eleven animals began to get separated and fled in different directions.
The horse escaped for a long time with its extremely fast speed, but was finally stuck here.
"It seems you haven't given up yet."
The tall, thin old man said with a sneer.
While speaking, he suddenly stretched out his right hand, and his ten fingers continued to lengthen and become curved, and then the entire palm turned into a sharp bird's claw, grabbing at the horse.
A large number of strange runes circled the bird's claws, sealing the space in front of it.
The horse immediately felt that the space he was in was being horribly suppressed. His body sank and his movements began to become difficult.
This tall and thin old man is a second-level god with great strength. Moreover, he is an elder of the Nine-Headed Bird Clan and has practiced many core inheritances of the Nine-Headed Bird Clan. Although it was just a casual grab, the core secret technique of the Nine-Headed Bird was already used, and its power was terrifying.
“We in the Great Underworld are very interested in this horse’s corpse and soul body.
Well, you, the Nine-Headed Bird Clan, can take its original bloodline, but its body still has a soul, so we in the Great Underworld will keep it. "
Suddenly, a man in black robe landed in front of everyone and spoke.
"The God of the Great Underworld!"
The others couldn't help but shrink their eyes when they saw the man in black robes, showing a fearful expression.
The Great Underworld is a very powerful force in the Ninth Void.
“Before you take away all parts of his body, he must be handed over to our Guardian camp.
But don't worry, our Guardian camp doesn't need his body, we just want to use him as a bait to lure out a guy. "
Suddenly, a middle-aged man strode up from a distance and spoke.
"It seems that the Guardian camp has recognized Senior Ma's identity."
Ye Yunfei couldn't help but thought to himself when he saw the middle-aged man.
In fact, in the other eight voids, when Ye Yunfei led the troops to fight against the army of the Guardian camp, the eleven animals had already come out to participate in the battle to help deal with the troops of the Guardian camp. So the Guardian camp already knows about the existence of these eleven animals.
During this period, these eleven animals were hunted by so many powerful forces in the starry sky, and finally attracted the attention of the Guardian camp, and then they recognized the identities of these eleven animals.
